channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: North Korea fumes over upcoming US-South Korea military drills
item.description: Pyongyang has accused the US of pushing the world 'to the brink of nuclear war'.

item.title: Norway’s FM tells Al Jazeera the US war on Iran was not ‘smart’
item.description: Norway’s FM Espen Barth Eide says the Iran war failed to achieve its initial aims and strengthened hardliners in Tehran.

item.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
item.description: The mayor of Qusra says Israeli troops have been telling families to leave their houses, using some as barracks.

item.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
item.description: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.

item.title: Teens who fled Venezuela after deadly quakes caught in another disaster in Colombia
item.description: Deivi Delfín and his brother moved to Colombia after a quake in Venezuela killed their mother, but were caught in another deadly disaster.

item.title: ‘Justified’ or ’no business being there’? Tennessee munitions town loyal to Trump but divided on Iran
item.description: Hear from voters in Kingsport, home to a munitions plant supplying the US military, as tensions over the Iran war spark debate.

item.title: In shattered Cali, residents search for loved ones and signs of hope
item.description: Most deaths from the magnitude-7.4 quake were reported in Cali, Colombia’s third-most populous city, as crews search collapsed buildings for those still trapped.
